First release: a flock of up to five Microduck desk pets for your Mac, plus the Play / Inside / Build web page.

**Which file?**
- Apple Silicon Mac (M1, M2, M3, M4…): `Desktop-Microduck-mac-apple-silicon.zip`
- Intel Mac: `Desktop-Microduck-mac-intel.zip`
- Any computer or phone: open [`web/index.html`](https://github.com/mia-yanhl/desktop-microduck/blob/main/web/index.html) in a browser

Unzip, drag **Desktop Microduck** into Applications, and open it. The app isn't signed with an Apple developer certificate, so the first time macOS asks: on macOS 15 or newer go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**; on older versions right-click the app → **Open**.

Unofficial fan project. Microduck's name and design belong to Pollen Robotics.
